theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.predicate_iff_rejected_clauses
theorems.statement:
theorem predicate_iff_rejected_clauses (k : Nat)
    (Q : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) (x : Fin k → Bool) :
    Q x = true ↔
      ∀ a : Fin k → Bool, Q a = false → ∃ i : Fin k, x i ≠ a i

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.conjunction_iff_rejected_clauses
theorems.statement:
theorem conjunction_iff_rejected_clauses {J : Type u}
    (k : J → Nat)
    (Q : (j : J) → (Fin (k j) → Bool) → Bool)
    (x : (j : J) → Fin (k j) → Bool) :
    (∀ j : J, Q j (x j) = true) ↔
      (∀ (j : J) (a : Fin (k j) → Bool),
        Q j a = false → ∃ i : Fin (k j), x j i ≠ a i)

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.disjunction_of_conjunctions_iff_rejected_clauses
theorems.statement:
theorem disjunction_of_conjunctions_iff_rejected_clauses
    {T : Type u} {J : T → Type v}
    (k : (t : T) → J t → Nat)
    (Q : (t : T) → (j : J t) → (Fin (k t j) → Bool) → Bool)
    (x : (t : T) → (j : J t) → Fin (k t j) → Bool) :
    (∃ t : T, ∀ j : J t, Q t j (x t j) = true) ↔
      (∃ t : T, ∀ (j : J t) (a : Fin (k t j) → Bool),
        Q t j a = false → ∃ i : Fin (k t j), x t j i ≠ a i)

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.assignments_complete
theorems.statement:
theorem assignments_complete : ∀ (k : Nat) (a : Fin k → Bool),
    a ∈ assignments k

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.mem_truthTableCNF
theorems.statement:
theorem mem_truthTableCNF (k : Nat) (Q : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
    (a : Fin k → Bool) : a ∈ truthTableCNF k Q ↔ Q a = false

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.truthTableCNF_correct
theorems.statement:
theorem truthTableCNF_correct (k : Nat)
    (Q : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) (x : Fin k → Bool) :
    Q x = true ↔
      ∀ a : Fin k → Bool, a ∈ truthTableCNF k Q → ∃ i : Fin k, x i ≠ a i

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.truthTableCNF_length_le
theorems.statement:
theorem truthTableCNF_length_le (k : Nat) (Q : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool) :
    (truthTableCNF k Q).length ≤ 2 ^ k

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.truthTableCNF_true
theorems.statement: theorem truthTableCNF_true (k : Nat) : truthTableCNF k (fun _ => true) = []

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.truthTableCNF_false
theorems.statement:
theorem truthTableCNF_false (k : Nat) :
    truthTableCNF k (fun _ => false) = assignments k

theorems.name: LocalPredicateCNF.truthTableCNF_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem truthTableCNF_zero (Q : (Fin 0 → Bool) → Bool) :
    truthTableCNF 0 Q =
      if Q (fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i) then [] else [fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i]

construction.assignments: Recursively enumerate Fin k -> Bool with a false first coordinate, then true; the k=0 list has the unique empty assignment.
construction.truthTableCNF: Filter assignments k by fun a => !(Q a); each list element a encodes the clause exists i : Fin k, x i != a i, where != here means propositional inequality.
construction.clause_representation: A Fin k -> Bool rejected pattern, not a list of literal syntax; its k coordinates encode the k literals.
construction.width: Each clause is indexed by Fin k, with one mismatch literal per coordinate.

limitations: The count 2^k is exponential in k; no polynomial-size or polynomial-time transfer is claimed.
Disjunction-of-conjunctions lifting preserves an outer existential; it does not flatten that expression into one CNF.
Clauses are encoded as rejected bit patterns with quantified semantics; there is no DIMACS serializer or separate Boolean evaluator.
No P versus NP, circuit lower bound, or family112 theorem is checked.
The reported standard Lean dependencies propext and Quot.sound are not new axioms declared by this file.
